engineering_basis: Existing deterministic P0 witnesses distinguish explicit lower NO from unavailable lower prerequisites. This candidate preserves raw records and historical scoring defaults; it is a hypothesis for decision utility, not a claimed human-alignment gain.

execution.input: One exact verified native replay and normalized complete original verdict bank per artifact/endpoint/cycle, with its frozen modules, bundle and actual task contract.
execution.projection_admission: Original admission copied; effective projected states receive no new semantic admission or native votes.

pair_decision.allowed_pairs: Only source-registered quality pairs within the same target/task/reference-condition/fine-variant stratum, with preserved orientation and provenance; no global disconnected-graph ranking.
pair_decision.artifact_score: Primary uses the single common registered initial cycle repeat0 observed score for each artifact; require a complete admitted bank and valid hard gates. Missing/unadmitted initial banks make that artifact prediction unavailable. Do not require or impute unplanned repeats.
pair_decision.direction: Compare the two artifact means; positive difference selects the higher-scored artifact, exact zero is a predicted tie. No fitted tie epsilon or calibration.
pair_decision.tie_abstention_missing_and_invalid_predi: No correct decision in the primary all-planned binary-preference ballot denominator; report each category separately.
pair_decision.source_human_ties_unknowns_or_missing_la: Preserve source categories and planned IDs. Report separate counts and best/worst bounds; do not silently delete them or claim they are binary ground truth.
pair_decision.decision_coverage: Directional usable predictions divided by all source-registered planned pairs, with complete-case coverage additionally reported.
pair_decision.primary_accuracy: Correct binary quality decisions divided by all registered planned binary-preference ballots; missing predictions contribute zero correct decisions. Majority-pair agreement is reported separately.
pair_decision.readiness_bounds: Descriptive rubric-sensitivity bounds and effective positive/penalty completeness, not statistical confidence or a primary strict-interval pair rule.
pair_decision.repeat_diagnostics: Report registered repeat1/2 sentinel decisions separately with their actual planned denominators; do not average them into primary initial scores or count absent unplanned cycles as measurement loss.

prospective_claim_rules.coverage_guard: Candidate directional decision coverage must be at least baseline coverage in every claimed stratum; selective accuracy alone is insufficient.
prospective_claim_rules.expert_improvement: Candidate all-planned accuracy point gain at least 0.05 and paired clustered 95-percent lower bound strictly above zero on each claimed endpoint; report effects and uncertainty even if the gate fails.
prospective_claim_rules.lay_noninferiority: Report separately; paired clustered 95-percent lower bound at least -0.03 for a noninferiority claim. An improvement claim additionally requires positive all-planned point gain and lower bound above zero.
prospective_claim_rules.resampling: Fixed seed20261004,1000 paired source-target cluster resamples; retain writer/rater reuse and crossed-rater sensitivity. Do not bootstrap correlated ballots as independent works.
prospective_claim_rules.attrition: More than10percent source-group loss or material arm-dependent attrition makes the improvement claim inconclusive; report all-planned best/worst bounds.
prospective_claim_rules.precision_extension: No automatic extension. If needed, freeze one independent extension and combined analysis before its labels.
prospective_claim_rules.negative_or_inconclusive_result: Retain candidate and lineage without promotion; continue the baseline/comparator program and consider a distinct supported mechanism.

cohorts.development_scope: Existing two-target canary:13artifacts,868planned requests,170leaf22packet short-form banks. This is development only; actual triggering patterns were not read for selection.
cohorts.confirmation_lead: Thirty source-disjoint Author-Style targets from the metadata partition; their quality-pair assignment, requests and planned ballot IDs are not yet frozen or verified by this profile.
cohorts.label_release_prerequisites: Exact outcome-blind source/pair/panel/condition/ballot membership and candidate/baseline/comparator request commitments; completed prediction dispositions and supported native replay; program-local eligibility decision; explicit postprediction label release. This profile does not authorize label opening.
cohorts.if_unused_eligibility_cannot_be_establis: Record the exact eligibility limitation. Any later outcome-blind benchmark must be separately labeled as such and must not claim unused confirmation.

compatibility_limit: Existing strict_interval_comparison_v1 rejects differing full successor scoring-context/task-contract commitments. Thirteen MFA artifacts have thirteen full task-contract hashes despite one rendered-context hash. A caller digest cannot override this; any future interval pair adapter requires a separately verified semantic-context contract preserving original hashes.
